origin.source_work: Stephen King, The Dead Zone (1979 novel)
origin.note: The novel supplies a design pattern. JANUS authority comes only from the explicit system contract below, not from fictional truth claims.

laws.janus_effect: Absence, inaccessible data, timeout, parser failure, permission failure and unqueried state cannot produce a negative factual verdict.

laws.refinement: SILENCE must be typed into UNKNOWN | INACCESSIBLE | NOT_QUERIED | TRANSPORT_FAILURE | PARSE_FAILURE when possible.
laws.janus_effect: Every silent observation should preserve reason/provenance rather than collapse to one null value.
A successful observation channel may still contain explicit dead zones. Completeness must be separately proved.
A query/request/scan is recorded separately from whether it yielded usable evidence.
Any JANUS action that can change the measured system invalidates dependent predictions, recommendations and cached conclusions until refreshed.

laws.formal: OBSERVE -> DECIDE -> ACT -> WORLD_UPDATE -> REOBSERVE -> REVERIFY
laws.janus_effect: Closed-loop work must re-measure the world after an intervention instead of treating the pre-action model as current.
Success/failure is judged from post-action evidence and causal receipts, not from the intended mechanism alone.
Every prediction or future-state claim should bind to an evidence snapshot/hash/timestamp where available.

laws.formal: WORLD_VERSION_i != WORLD_VERSION_j => CLAIM_i cannot silently inherit CURRENT authority at j
laws.janus_effect: Receipts remain historically valid but cannot silently masquerade as current-state evidence.

after_intervention_protocol: compare expected vs realized causal path
preserve old snapshot as history, never overwrite provenance

TRUMP_specific_application.rule: Any transformation, decomposition, representation switch, learned obstruction or proof-system change that alters the active mathematical state forces re-evaluation of downstream claims against the new state.
forbidden: reuse a pre-transformation complexity estimate as current without proof
reuse a terminal classification after a state-changing transformation without exact recheck
treat an unrecognized route as a negative SAT/UNSAT result
treat absence of a proof as proof of absence
